facts.fact: Nimmi moved the seal from the woodpile to the pot of steeping walnut leaf by her chulha after Pinku, watching from the walnut tree, told her where Meera hid it.
facts.why: needed because the outline places the seal recovery in the chulha-corner pot, while ch24 hid it in the woodpile.

facts.fact: Meera keeps the brass button token tucked in the binding of the count, and the count was not taken from inside her shirt when she was searched.
facts.why: needed so the button and ledger page are available for the trade with Asha.

facts.fact: Asha confirms the lowland middleman was Varun's runner, a thin man with a bad left foot; Varun paid her four silver a week.
facts.why: outline requires Asha to confirm Varun paid her and the middleman was his runner.

facts.fact: Asha's crew has a stubborn salt-road pony, which Kiran rides on the salt-road path to Garh Neshar.
facts.why: Kiran is recovering from fever and needs to travel.

facts.fact: Varun left at midnight on the Garh road with his twenty men, expecting Ranu to burn.
facts.why: explains why Varun is absent during the escape.

facts.fact: Nimmi says Meera's ring and little fingers must come off a day after the Fair; the middle finger will live.
facts.why: outline beat; fixes timing of the amputation.
